title: Graphics configuration validation
summary: A saved-profile comparison and package-integrity study for a Windows graphics experiment. The result separates configuration changes, recorded tests and live rendering acceptance.
ownership: Project owner; AI-assisted tooling, investigation, testing and documentation. No authorship of upstream rendering technology is claimed.
method: Pin saved inputs with SHA-256 before comparing them.
Compare parsed INI keys and values, keeping changed and unchanged settings separate.
Reconcile saved evidence and package members against recorded hashes.
Retain historical test records and unresolved runtime and recovery limits.

comparison.scope: Saved INI keys and values only; no runtime load or image-quality inference.

verification.scope: Read-only local hash reconciliation and independent semantic comparison. Test counts describe preserved earlier logs, not a new test run.

limits: Saved configuration equality does not prove that a game or rendering runtime loaded the settings.
No current controlled performance capture, accepted image-quality comparison or verified final-build FPS is provided.
Installer scenarios are historical. Complete backup validation before every restore write and transactional recovery are not established.
Source-record hashes identify preserved private records; their full contents and the original installer are not reproduced here.
This page distributes no game assets, screenshots, third-party binaries, model weights or renderer implementation.
No DLSS port, NVIDIA affiliation, binary authenticity or production reliability claim is made.
hiring_relevance: QA: define expected results, compare versions and preserve negative or unresolved outcomes.
IT Support: verify file identity and configuration drift before interpreting a successful operation.
Automation: produce structured results with explicit evidence boundaries.
public_evidence_status: Sanitized derived summary; saved private records are not independently reproducible from this page.
